entities.name: Museum of the Nationalist Forces in Balıkesir
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Museum of the Nationalist Forces in Balıkesir is a museum in Balıkesir, Turkey, dedicated to the irregular Kuva-yi Milliye formed as part of the Turkish National Movement during the Turkish War of Independence (1919–1923).
